query: Which clinical factors best explain longer visit durations?

per_column.name: procedure_performed
per_column.rationale: A candidate clinical cause whose effect on visit duration is plausibly being attributed; performing a procedure directly lengthens a visit.

per_column.name: chronic_condition_count
per_column.rationale: Patient comorbidity burden plausibly increases the likelihood of procedures/referrals (treatment) AND independently lengthens visits, so it is a common cause. Not named in the query.

per_column.name: systems_involved_count
per_column.rationale: Clinical complexity (number of body systems) plausibly drives both whether a procedure/consult is done and the outcome duration; a genuine common cause surfaced from the data, not in the query.

per_column.name: referral_or_consult
per_column.rationale: Another candidate clinical cause of longer duration; obtaining a consult adds time. Functions as an alternative treatment rather than a common cause.

per_column.name: medication_mentions
per_column.rationale: Medication reconciliation/mentions plausibly lie on the path from complexity to longer duration and are downstream of clinical activity rather than a common cause of a specific treatment; treating it as a confounder would be an error.

per_column.name: note_word_count
per_column.rationale: Note length is an artifact of both the visit content and its duration (longer visits produce longer notes); it is downstream/effect, a mechanical text-length proxy, not a common cause. Adjusting for it would induce bias.

judge.rationale: The set supplies clear candidate treatments (procedure_performed, referral_or_consult) and two plausible common causes of both treatment and outcome (chronic_condition_count, systems_involved_count) that were surfaced from the data rather than copied from the query, demonstrating some genuine causal reasoning. However the set is diluted: medication_mentions reads as a mediator and note_word_count is a mechanical text-length/collider proxy, neither of which are valid confounders. Existing table variables (department, urgency, age_group) are the more obvious confounders and were not among the added columns. Confounder quality is moderate because the two genuine confounders are reasonable but the augmentation mixes in mediators/colliders.
